text:
The canvas holds:
pay-someone-new — Entry screen for the MVP's core solution (seq 7: payee-creation API callable from the app channel) scoped to a single UK sort-code/account-number payee (seq 12's in-bounds case). Includes a hidden modal-dialog for the close-match decision customers must resolve unaided (seq 6, seq 23) before continuing.
confirm-and-send — Follows pay-someone-new once Confirmation of Payee has run: shows the match result and the first-payment limit (seq 23's stated refusal — no skipping the check, a cap on day one), and carries the scam-intervention decision as a hidden modal-dialog (seq 8, seq 17: the screen must do the job the agent's ear used to do) whose shown text and the customer's response are exactly what the audit trail and security boundary require (seq 14, seq 30).
payment-sent — Closes the journey confirm-and-send commits to: the completion point seq 16's eval counts toward the 85% first-attempt-without-a-call pass rate, and the record shown here (payee, amount, reference, timestamp) is the customer-facing slice of the audit trail seq 18/19 require to be kept in order.

Next: the screen where the customer chooses the amount and sends the first payment.

input.why: The amount-entry and send step itself, separated from confirm-and-send's match-result/warning decision: enforces the first-payment limit stated as a day-one refusal (seq 23) and is the interaction the two-second/three-minute performance budget (seq 27) is measured against.

props.hint: You can send up to £250 to a new payee today.

props.content: Enter an amount of £250 or less to continue.

text: Screen **choose-amount** has been proposed: a dedicated amount-entry step between confirm-and-send's match/warning decision and payment-sent's receipt. It states the first-payment limit inline rather than as a decision (seq 23's refusal is a hard rule, not a question, so it's a `text` line, not a `modal-dialog`), and this is the interaction seq 27's two-second check / three-minute journey budget is measured against. "Send payment" is the screen's one committing action, carrying straight into payment-sent.
